project_metadata.name: ChessZen Classes
project_metadata.description: Premium, modern, mobile-first website targeting parents and advanced learners. The design evokes intellectual depth, strategy, and luxury through dark tones and gold accents.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#F3C53C] text-black font-semibold rounded-none px-8 py-4 transition-colors duration-300 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 font-semibold rounded-none px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300

cards.base: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-500 p-8

forms.input: bg-[#0A0A0A] border-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] rounded-none transition-all
forms.label: text-sm text-zinc-300 font-medium mb-2 block

hero_background.description: Cinematic glass chess piece on dark board for Hero section
hero_background.usage: Hero section background with dark overlay bg-black/60

texture_bg.description: Dark moody abstract background with geometric gold lines
texture_bg.usage: Background for Why ChessZen or specific dark sections

programs_bg.description: Elegant macro shot of a golden pawn on a wooden chessboard

header.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#050505]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 transition-all
header.logo: Text 'ChessZen Classes' in Playfair Display with gold accent on 'Zen'
header.navigation: Visible links on desktop, gold hover states. Mobile menu full screen dark overlay.

hero.layout: Full screen height (min-h-screen). Absolute background image with bg-black/70 overlay. Content centrally aligned or asymmetrical 8-col grid.
hero.content: H1 title mapping intellectual growth to chess. CTA group (Primary: View Programs, Secondary: Contact Coach)

about_coach.layout: Asymmetrical split. Left: Large Portrait with subtle gold glow. Right: Credentials.
about_coach.details: Highlight FIDE ID: 537023560, AICF ID: 266194UP2024, Chess.com 1874, Lichess 2127, MTech NIT Surathkal. Use monospaced font for rating numbers for a technical/precision feel.

programs.layout: 3 Column Grid. Cards with dark flat backgrounds, 1px subtle white/10 borders.
programs.content: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced. Highlight the target audience, duration, and key focus. Add a subtle gold top-border on hover.

why_chesszen.layout: Bento Grid pattern. Mix square and wide rectangles.
why_chesszen.visuals: Use high contrast typography and sparse icons (lucide-react stroke 1.5).

testimonials.layout: Horizontal scroll / Carousel setup (Swiper or pure CSS snap scroll).
testimonials.cards: Crystal Glass style (bg-white/[0.02]) with gold quote icons.
testimonials.submission: Include a prominent 'Submit your review' button triggering a Shadcn dialog.

contact_enquiry.layout: Split section: Left form, Right contact info & Google Map.
contact_enquiry.actions: Prominent WhatsApp and Direct Call buttons. Form uses strict border-bottom-only inputs for a high-end editorial feel.

footer.content: Large typography for brand name. Minimal links.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: MANDATORY: Implement lenis smooth scrolling for premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Framer Motion for staggered fade-ups on scroll.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons translate-y-[-2px] with increased shadow. Cards reveal a subtle gold glow on border.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) MUST include 'data-testid' in kebab-case format.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white/gold text on #050505 background meets WCAG AA standards. Form labels must be visible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind for all styling. Configure tailwind.config.js to extend colors with brand_gold (#D4AF37) and background_primary (#050505).
Import Playfair Display (serif) and Manrope (sans-serif) via Google Fonts in index.css.
Strictly follow the Dark Theme. Do not use generic white backgrounds.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for structural layout (bento grids, asymmetrical sections) instead of rigid Shadcn layout components.
Use Shadcn UI ONLY for complex logic forms (Dialog, Accordion, Select, Form, Carousel), but heavily strip Vercel-look to match the premium dark/gold luxury theme.
Ensure the Mobile experience is fully responsive (max image heights 80vh, grid-cols-1 on mobile).
Admin Panel: Create a simple dashboard for Testimonial moderation (Accept/Reject). Use a flat dark table.
Never use generic placeholder images. ONLY use the provided media_urls.
